aut.name: Shady Meadows B&B (Restful Booker Platform demo)
aut.notes: UI + JSON API. Shared public sandbox: data is reset periodically and other people write to it.

applicationDefects.title: Messages API exposes guest enquiries without authentication
applicationDefects.rationale: AC-8: list and detail require a staff token and must return 401 without it. Both return 200 with data to anonymous callers; the detail includes guest e-mail, phone and message text (personal data). Security/privacy defect: the token is not checked on these endpoints. (Confirmed in run 06-seeded; identical failure signature in 07-presteps.)
applicationDefects.liveCheck: Replayed live on 2026-09-26 (tier 3) without any cookie: GET /api/message → 200 with messages; GET /api/message/1 → 200 with email/phone/description (confirm/SCN-009.md, SCN-010.md)
steps: When I GET /api/message without a token
Then the response status is 401
And the response contains no message data

applicationDefects.title: Message field label is not associated with its textarea
applicationDefects.actual: element not found: getByRole('textbox', { name: 'Message', exact: true })
applicationDefects.rationale: The strict AC-1 assertion requires every field to be exposed with its accessible name. Name/Email/Phone/Subject pass; Message has no accessible name. Root cause found live: <label for="message"> points to a non-existent id, while the textarea's id is "description", so screen readers announce an unlabeled edit field (WCAG 1.3.1/4.1.2). Automatic triage correctly flagged a strict-assertion failure. (Confirmed in run 06-seeded; identical failure signature in 07-presteps.)
applicationDefects.liveCheck: Live on 2026-09-26 (tier 3): getByRole('textbox', {name:'Message'}) → 0; label[for=message] exists, textarea#description has no aria-label/aria-labelledby (runs/03-eval/confirm/UI-SCN-001-019.md) · Tier-2 cross-check (Playwright MCP, 2026-09-26): on a ready page Name/Email/Phone/Subject are exposed as textboxes, Message is not (hardening/tier2/a11y-confirm.md).
steps: Given I am on the home page
Then I see the "Send Us a Message" form
And the fields Name, Email, Phone, Subject and Message are each exposed with that accessible name
And I see a "Submit" button

applicationDefects.title: Malformed JSON returns 500 instead of 400
applicationDefects.rationale: AC-7: a non-JSON body is a client error and must be 400, never 5xx. The API answers 500 {"error":"Failed to create message"}: server-side failure on client input, which also pollutes error monitoring. (Confirmed in run 06-seeded; identical failure signature in 07-presteps.)
applicationDefects.liveCheck: Replayed live on 2026-09-26 (tier 3): POST /api/message with a truncated JSON body → 500 (confirm/SCN-008.md)
steps: When I POST a body that is not valid JSON to /api/message
Then the response status is 400

applicationDefects.title: Unknown room id returns 500 instead of 404
applicationDefects.rationale: AC-12 / api-contract.md: an unknown id must return 404. The API returns 500 Internal Server Error, so an unhandled not-found condition surfaces as a server fault. (Confirmed in run 06-seeded; identical failure signature in 07-presteps.)
steps: Given I know an id that no room has
When I GET /api/room/{id}
Then the response status is 404

applicationDefects.title: Idempotency-Key is ignored: a retried enquiry is stored twice
applicationDefects.rationale: AC-16(a) / api-contract.md v1.5: repeating POST /api/message with the same Idempotency-Key must store the enquiry once. Both calls answered 2xx (that part passes) but the staff list contains the subject twice. The header is ignored, so double-clicks and network retries create duplicate enquiries (the support problem that triggered rev 2). (Confirmed in run 06-seeded; identical failure signature in 07-presteps.)
applicationDefects.liveCheck: Replayed live on 2026-09-26 (tier 3, api-probe): two POSTs with header Idempotency-Key → 200, 200; authenticated GET /api/message lists the unique subject 2× (runs/04-rerun/confirm/SCN-021-*.md, SCN-021-list.json)
steps: Given I am authenticated as staff
And a valid enquiry with a unique subject and a unique Idempotency-Key
When I POST that enquiry to /api/message twice with the same Idempotency-Key
Then both responses are 2xx
And the authenticated message list contains that subject exactly once

traceability.text: The home page contains a "Send Us a Message" form with the fields Name, Email, Phone, Subject and Message and a "Submit" button. Every field has a programmatically associated label that screen readers announce (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.3.1 / 4.1.2).

scenarios.title: Contact form offers every field with an accessible label

traceability.text: Submitting a valid form replaces it with the heading "Thanks for getting in touch <Name>!" followed by "We'll get back to you about <Subject> as soon as possible." (exact copy in ux-copy.md).

scenarios.title: A valid enquiry shows the personalised confirmation

traceability.text: Submitting the form with every field empty keeps the form on screen and shows validation errors that mention every one of the five fields. Nothing is sent to staff.

scenarios.title: An empty submission keeps the form and reports every field

traceability.text: Field rules and boundaries are defined in the attached field-rules.csv. The UI and the API enforce the same rules. A value exactly on a boundary is valid; one character outside it is invalid.

scenarios.title: The UI rejects a value one character outside a boundary
sources: story AC-4, field-rules.csv (UI sample of the shared rules)

scenarios.title: The API enforces field boundaries
sources: story AC-4 / AC-6, field-rules.csv (full boundary matrix)

traceability.text: POST /api/message with a body that satisfies every field rule creates the enquiry. The response is 201 Created with the JSON body {"success": true}.

scenarios.title: Creating a valid enquiry returns 201 Created

traceability.text: POST /api/message with one or more invalid fields responds 400 Bad Request. The body is a JSON array of human-readable error strings containing, for each violated length rule, the exact message from field-rules.csv. The enquiry is not stored.

scenarios.title: The API enforces field boundaries
sources: story AC-4 / AC-6, field-rules.csv (full boundary matrix)

scenarios.title: A rejected enquiry is not stored

traceability.text: A request body that is not valid JSON is a client error. POST /api/message responds 400 Bad Request, never a 5xx.

scenarios.title: A malformed JSON body is a client error

traceability.text: GET /api/message (list) and GET /api/message/{id} (detail) contain guests' personal data and require a valid staff token. Without a token they respond 401 Unauthorized and return no message data. With a valid token (cookie token, obtained from POST /api/auth/login) the list responds 200 with {"messages": [{"id", "name", "subject", "read"}]}.

scenarios.title: Listing enquiries without a staff token is refused
Reading an enquiry without a staff token is refused
Staff can list enquiries with a valid token

traceability.text: POST /api/auth/login with valid staff credentials responds 200 with {"token": "<non-empty string>"}. Invalid credentials respond 401 with {"error": "Invalid credentials"}.

scenarios.title: Valid staff credentials return a token
Invalid staff credentials are refused

traceability.text: An enquiry submitted through the UI form can be read by staff: it appears in the authenticated GET /api/message list with the same name and subject.

scenarios.title: An enquiry sent from the UI is readable by staff through the API

traceability.text: GET /api/room responds 200 with {"rooms": [...]}. Every room follows the Room schema in api-contract.md: roomid integer, roomName string, type one of Single, Twin, Double, Family, Suite, accessible boolean, roomPrice integer greater than 0, features array of strings, image string, description string.

scenarios.title: The rooms list follows the Room schema

traceability.text: GET /api/room/{id} responds 200 with a single Room for an existing id, and 404 Not Found for an id that does not exist.

scenarios.title: An existing room can be fetched by id
An unknown room id returns 404

traceability.text: Every room returned by GET /api/room is shown in "Our Rooms" with its type and its price formatted as "£<roomPrice> per night".

scenarios.title: Every API room is shown with its type and nightly price

traceability.text: Each room card image has alternative text that names that room's type, e.g. "Double Room" (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.1.1).

scenarios.title: Room card images name their own room type

traceability.text: (NFR-1) GET /api/room responds in under 3000 ms for each of 5 consecutive requests from the test environment.

scenarios.title: The rooms list responds quickly

traceability.text: (rev 2) Retries are safe. (a) Repeating POST /api/message with the same Idempotency-Key request header (e.g. a network retry or double-click) stores the enquiry only once: every repeat answers 2xx and no duplicate appears in the staff list. (b) GET endpoints are idempotent: repeating GET /api/room/{id} returns an identical body.

scenarios.title: A retried enquiry with the same Idempotency-Key is stored only once
Repeating GET /api/room/{id} returns an identical body
